subject: Post-demo follow-up: token economics and per-model share
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
To: Claire Boyd <claire@atlasai.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-09-14T09:10:00-07:00
Subject: Post-demo follow-up: token economics and per-model share

Hi Claire —

Thanks again for the demo time this morning. Quick recap and a few concrete asks so we can put together a pricing proposal that maps to the metrics that matter for AtlasAI.

What we covered:
- Target UIs: search + contextual chat + content generation for support flows
- Key traffic patterns: bursts during peak support hours, steady baseline overnight
- Data sensitivity: PII in transcripts (you flagged SOC2 + VPC requirements)

Action items from our side:
1) Ask from you: ballpark token volumes (monthly) broken down by intent type if possible (chat/generation vs. embeddings vs. rerank). If you can give ranges that’s fine — we’ll show TEEs for low/med/high.
2) Ask from you: budget range you’re comfortable with or target $/1M tokens (helps us recommend model mix).

Preliminary notes (very rough):
- If you’re in the ~10–50M tokens/month range, we typically recommend a blended approach: cheaper chat variants for high-volume prompt-complete flows, larger chat models for small % of long-form or high-precision flows, embeddings for vector search and reranking on the retriever pipeline.
- Ballpark unit economics: depending on batching, cache hit rate, and model choice, we typically see an effective cost of $400–$1,200 per 1M tokens for production chat workloads across model tiers (we’ll refine this once we have exact volumes and timelength distribution).

Suggested next steps:
- Can you send a 30/60/90 day expected token envelope? If you prefer a single monthly run rate, that’s okay.
- Can procurement confirm any contractual timing (SOW/PO timeline)?

I attached a quick calculator that turns monthly volumes into an estimated monthly bill under a few model-mix scenarios. I’ll stand up a tailored quote once we have your ranges.

Attachment: MAA-token-calcs.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Thanks —
Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
stephanie@redwood.com | (415) 555-0192

From: Claire Boyd <claire@atlasai.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-09-14T13:35:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo follow-up: token economics and per-model share

Hi Stephanie —

Appreciate the summary. Quick answers below — will follow up with a short CSV export of sample month traffic later today.

Estimated steady-state (month):
- Total tokens: about 30,000,000 / month (this is our internal estimate after normalizing prompt/response lengths)
- Model breakdown (current best guess):
  - Chat/generation (customer-facing chat + support answers): ~22M tokens (≈73%)
  - Embeddings (search & semantic similarity): ~1.0M embedding vectors (roughly 300k–350k embedding calls; each call returns vectors — call volume is a better metric here)
  - Rerank / scoring (server-side reranker): ~50k requests (smaller token footprint but latency sensitive)
  - Misc / system tokens: remainder

Budget: we are aiming for an effective cost target of around $750 per 1M tokens (this is an internal target — flexible if the performance tradeoffs are compelling).

Contract timing: procurement will likely want a short SOW + 30-day payment terms; I’ve CC’d procurement at procurement@atlasai.com to coordinate any PO details.

Thanks — will send the export shortly.

—Claire
Claire Boyd | Head of Product, AtlasAI
claire@atlasai.com

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
To: Claire Boyd <claire@atlasai.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-09-14T16:00:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo follow-up: token economics and per-model share

Claire —

Thanks for the quick numbers, very helpful. Based on 30M tokens / month and your $750 target, I sketched out a recommended model mix and an estimated effective $/1M tokens that factors in batching, prefix caching for chat, and embedding bulk discounts. High level:

Recommended model mix (initial rollout):
- Chat / generation (conversational): Redwood-chat-3-small (or equivalent) — route ~65–75% of chat tokens here for cost efficiency
- Chat (high-precision flows): Redwood-chat-3-large — reserve for ~5–10% of completions where precision matters (billing at higher per-token cost)
- Embeddings: Redwood-embed-2 (dense vector model) — use for vectoring + semantic search (we price per-embed call differently; included in calc sheet)
- Rerank: lightweight reranker (redwood-rerank-lite) for the 50k requests — we recommend colocating reranker close to retriever to hit latency SLOs

Estimated effective cost (very preliminary):
- Baseline: $760 / 1M tokens (assumes 65% chat-small, 8% chat-large, 27% system/embeddings/rerank amortization)
- With higher batching and 25% prefix cache hit on common prompts: $610 / 1M tokens
- If you push 80% to chat-small (aggressive): $520 / 1M tokens (with small degrade on rare high-precision responses)

Notes:
- Embedding pricing is presented per-1000 vectors in the calc sheet; since you listed ~300k calls we applied the volume discount at the 250k+ tier.
- We can run a 2-week pilot with limited quota to validate effective unit econ and cache hit assumptions; that will let us firm up a final quote.

Next steps:
1) If procurement confirms PO cadence, we can issue an initial pilot quote (30-day pilot + conversion terms).
2) Rishi — can you draft a pilot quote + SOW based on the 30M/month envelope and the two pricing scenarios (conservative vs aggressive routing)? I attached the calc we’ll use to generate the quote.

Attachments: redwood-pricing-quote.pdf, MAA-token-calcs.xlsx

Thanks —
Stephanie
